original_title: Live: Iran declares 60-day memorandum of understanding negotiation deadline null and void
title: Live: Iran declares 60-day memorandum of understanding negotiation deadline null and void
original_summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said the 60-day negotiation deadline set out under the June Iran-US memorandum of understanding for a lasting settlement had been rendered null and void by "violations" committed by Washington. After meeting with Benjamin Netanyahu, US envoy Jared Kushner said Monday he hoped to see the start of Hamas's disarmament within "30 days". Follow the latest developments.
